limitations: FC uses up to twice F pixel budget; duplicate-full fusion equals F numerically and is the matched-count redundancy control.
FCH/FCW jointly encode images and hints; their difference measures wrong-hint sensitivity, not a pure crop effect.
No accepted crop does not imply the requested object is absent.
Same test scenes previously inspected; exploratory follow-up, not a new blind test.
One apartment per split and only two open development/test frames.
C-only coverage differs; compare correct/all-known and missing counts, not conditional F1 alone.
Correct detector hints contain false predictions as well as true objects.
No generative verifier quality claim; these are frozen embedding baselines.
